master.chosen: hgi_mtp_native (rtl/hbm_accel/generic/hgi_mtp_native.sv) = hfd_mtp_x_cp_stop EXTERNAL_AM=1 (native full-context DSpark controller, gamma 5 / 40 layers / WR 256 / RLOG 16'h0111 / SR 10 / CKMAX 2^20 / XSEL / STOP+EOS) behind the 197/517 CP facade, without the 523-bit su_red logit group; CP south band = hfd_cmdproc_s_mtp_native_mx1 (MX1: transaction join, finite-8 emit queue, drained reset)
why: On the generic die the argmax is a program record: ARGMAX.LOCAL in the ARGMAX unit (unit 7, ot_hgi_argmax18_m) + COLL.ARGMAX_MERGE.  The master must take the MERGED id from the CP (EXTERNAL_AM / CP-result form).  hfd_mtp (r25m) and hgi's ot_hgi_mtp_core18 both carry an internal shard argmax (AMF) fed by a 523-bit logit bus plus an am -> coll -> merged loop: a second argmax beside the ARGMAX unit.

core18 is the legacy x-master interface (16-bit prompt/forced addresses, no EOS/stop, no 1M-context counters); the cp_stop lineage has 20-bit positions, 21-bit counters, EOS / max-position stop and the checked CP-result input, and is already paired with the MX1 CP (t_mtp 197 / f_mtp 517 / f_am 18) and its connected closed-control bench.

Token width 17: DS vocab 129,280 < 2^17.  The generic interface's 18-bit ids are cp_vocab-checked by the CP before f_am (bit 17 is 0 for DS).  Qwen MTP is reserved (HBM_GENERIC_INTERFACE 10.3); if the owner enables it after tau, the 18-bit controller is hgi's core18 lineage or this master at TW 18 (ot_hfd_mtp_core_cp_stop is TW-parameterised; MX1 join / backend / queue are 17-bit literal and would need widening).
